facts.statement: The study was a single-center retrospective cohort of consecutive patients with aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage who received endovascular embolization at a hospital in China between January 2022 and August 2025.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: The study included 259 patients, and 67 of them were given norepinephrine during their hospital stay.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: The main outcome measured was whether patients died from any cause within 28 days of the event.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: The 28-day mortality rate was 47.8% in the group that received norepinephrine and 15.7% in the group that did not.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: After adjusting for laboratory values and other relevant factors, norepinephrine use was associated with a higher risk of dying within 28 days.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: The authors state that prospective studies with detailed dose and duration data are needed to confirm these findings.
facts.subject: humans
